parameters.query:
WITH target_version AS (
    SELECT
        cv.id AS campaign_version_id,
        cv.campaign_id,
        cv.version_number,

        c.campaign_code,
        c.status AS campaign_status,

        cl.client_code,
        cl.name AS client_name,
        cl.company_name,
        cl.email AS client_email

    FROM campaign_versions cv

    JOIN campaigns c
        ON c.id = cv.campaign_id

    JOIN clients cl
        ON cl.id = c.client_id

    WHERE cv.id = $1::UUID

      AND cv.validation_status = 'passed'

      AND c.status = 'awaiting_approval'
),

save_approval AS (
    INSERT INTO approvals (
        campaign_version_id,
        decision,
        decision_token,
        expires_at
    )

    SELECT
        campaign_version_id,
        'pending',
        encode(
            gen_random_bytes(32),
            'hex'
        ),
        NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'

    FROM target_version

    ON CONFLICT (campaign_version_id)
    WHERE decision = 'pending'

    DO UPDATE SET
        decision_token =
            encode(
                gen_random_bytes(32),
                'hex'
            ),

        requested_at = NOW(),

        expires_at =
            NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days',

        reviewer_name = NULL,
        reviewer_email = NULL,
        feedback = NULL,
        decided_at = NULL

    RETURNING
        id,
        campaign_version_id,
        decision,
        decision_token,
        requested_at,
        expires_at
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '04 - Create Campaign Approval Request',

        target_version.campaign_id,

        'info',

        'approval_request_created',

        'A secure campaign review link was generated.',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'campaign_code',
                target_version.campaign_code,

            'campaign_version_id',
                target_version.campaign_version_id,

            'version_number',
                target_version.version_number,

            'expires_at',
                save_approval.expires_at
        )

    FROM target_version

    JOIN save_approval
        ON save_approval.campaign_version_id =
           target_version.campaign_version_id

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    save_approval.id::TEXT AS approval_id,

    save_approval.campaign_version_id::TEXT
        AS campaign_version_id,

    target_version.campaign_id::TEXT
        AS campaign_id,

    target_version.campaign_code,

    target_version.version_number,

    target_version.client_code,
    target_version.client_name,
    target_version.company_name,
    target_version.client_email,

    save_approval.decision,
    save_approval.decision_token,
    save_approval.requested_at,
    save_approval.expires_at

FROM save_approval

JOIN target_version
    ON target_version.campaign_version_id =
       save_approval.campaign_version_id;
